scenes.subject: A baker's hands piping cream buttercream rosettes around the top edge of a two-tier celebration cake decorated with soft butter-yellow and blush buttercream and a few fresh berries
scenes.setting: Flour-dusted pale oak work counter in a small bakery; a turntable under the cake; a bowl of buttercream, an offset spatula and a linen towel nearby
scenes.camera: 35mm, eye level with the cake, f/2.8; soft natural window light from the right
scenes.composition: Cake and hands in the right half; left 40% calm, softly blurred cream wall and counter
scenes.exclusions: No visible face; no text on aprons, piping bags or tools

scenes.subject: A three-tier wedding cake in smooth ivory buttercream with a cascade of fresh garden roses and greenery down one side, on a simple wooden cake stand
scenes.setting: Bright room with a cream linen backdrop and a pale wood side table
scenes.camera: 50mm, straight-on, f/4; large soft window light from the left, gentle shadow on the right
scenes.composition: Cake centred in the lower two-thirds; top third calm linen
scenes.exclusions: No toppers with names or initials; no people

scenes.subject: An open kraft-paper gift box filled with hand-decorated sugar cookies (flowers, hearts and scalloped rounds in cream, butter-yellow, blush and soft brown royal icing), tied with loose baker's twine
scenes.setting: Flour-dusted oak board seen from above; a few loose cookies, a piping cone and a sprig of dried flowers beside the box
scenes.camera: Overhead flat-lay, 50mm, f/5.6; soft daylight from the top left
scenes.composition: Box in the right half; left third of the board mostly empty
scenes.exclusions: No words, letters or numbers on cookies, box or tags

scenes.subject: Interior of a small, cosy bakery shop: a glass cake case holding several whole decorated cakes and rows of cookies, a wooden counter, and shelves with stacked kraft cake boxes behind
scenes.setting: Cream painted walls, warm oak shelves, a big front window letting in morning light, a jar of flowers on the counter
scenes.camera: 24mm, standing eye level, f/4; morning sun from the front window on the left
scenes.composition: Case and counter across the lower half; upper third calm wall and soft light
scenes.exclusions: No signs, chalkboards, menus, price tags or lettering anywhere; no people

scenes.subject: A wedding cake tasting: two people's hands with small forks sampling three small slices of layer cake on a tasting plate, with two cups of coffee and a fresh flower
scenes.setting: Small round wooden table by a window in the bakery, linen napkins
scenes.camera: 50mm, slightly above the table, f/2.2; window light from the left
scenes.composition: Plate and hands in the right two-thirds; left third soft blurred window light
scenes.exclusions: Hands and forearms only, no faces; one plain ring allowed; no text

scenes.subject: A homemade-looking celebration cake with lit thin candles on a family table, a child's hands reaching toward it in excitement; party plates and a few paper streamers
scenes.setting: Warm home dining table, cream tablecloth, background people softly blurred
scenes.camera: 35mm, at table height, f/2; warm candle glow plus soft ambient light
scenes.composition: Cake right of centre; left 35% dark, calm and softly out of focus
scenes.exclusions: No faces in focus; no number candles, banners or writing on the cake

scenes.subject: A friendly baker in a plain cream apron smoothing buttercream on a tall cake with a bench scraper, focused and smiling slightly
scenes.setting: The bakery work counter, oak shelves with mixing bowls behind, a dusting of flour in the air
scenes.camera: 50mm, waist-up, f/2.8; window light from the right
scenes.composition: Baker in the right half; left side calm, blurred shelves
scenes.exclusions: Not a real or famous person; no logo or text on the apron

scenes.subject: Baking ingredients for a cake: a block of butter on paper, brown eggs in a bowl, flour in a ceramic bowl with a scoop, a vanilla pod, a whisk and a few strawberries
scenes.setting: Flour-dusted oak counter with a linen towel
scenes.camera: Overhead three-quarter view, 50mm, f/4; soft side light from the left
scenes.composition: Ingredients loosely arranged around the edges; calm empty board in the centre-left
scenes.exclusions: No packaging, labels or brand names
